My dear friends, in recent years, during which…
entry.summary:
Machine-translated from the original Telegram post.

Source: @jafarshiralinia

For Iran — Jafar Shirali-Nia

My dear friends, in recent years, during which I have written less, I have accomplished a great deal, and together with several teams, we have pushed the work forward intensively and meticulously across several fields. We now have a "content production factory," and gradually I will introduce you, my dear companions of all these years, to its production lines.

I have no intention of abandoning contemporary Iranian history and war studies. I also have things to say about current affairs, which I will share with you soon.

On Sunday, 12 Mehr, we unveiled the book "Women Painters of Iran," published in English for international distribution. In the IBNA report, you can read my account of why I took up this subject:
https://www.ibna.ir/news/555863

Two other reports, in Ensaf News and Jamaran, have published the message of the respected thinker Mr. Seyyed Mohammad Khatami, along with photos from the ceremony:

Ensaf News:
https://ensafnews.com/?p=670513

Jamaran:
https://www.jamaran.news/fa/tiny/news-1730107

This project began with painting and the women of Iran, but it will not remain limited to painting and the women of Iran — it is meant to tell the story of the artistic experiences of women across West Asia. For now, those interested can follow the project's activities on the Martex Instagram page:
https://instagram.com/martexart

Our content production factory has four other pillars:
"Iranian Traces in the World" and "Islam Through Primary Sources," which I will discuss very soon; and two more that I will share with you a little later: "The History of Development and Industry in Iran and West Asia" and "Narrative of the Future."

I know we are in extremely difficult circumstances, and the scope of war will likely grow heavier. Soon, in a gathering, I will share with you the findings of my year-long research on war and its future. But no matter what, one must work and build; even if destruction lies ahead, the moment it passes, we must set out on the path of rebuilding.

From now on, I will speak with you more about the fruits of these past few years' work.

I am with you in the future room 👇
https://t.me/jafarshiralinia

About the unveiling event

Dear friends, hello,

Many of you have asked about attending the unveiling of the book "Women Painters of Iran," tomorrow, Sunday, 12 Mehr, at 5 PM at the Tehran Museum of Contemporary Art.

Attendance at this event is open to all, and no invitation card is needed. That said, the ceremony may get a bit crowded, and due to the hall's limited capacity, we may not be able to provide comfortable seating for all our dear guests.

At the same time, the museum is hosting an exhibition marking the two hundredth anniversary of photography, as well as an exhibition of selected works by women painters from the museum's collection, which is also a valuable opportunity to see. If the crowds at the ceremony are not to your liking, you can visit these remarkable exhibitions instead.

Hope to see you there.
